overall_scope: external candidate package and reused P1 panel toolchain only; not company target-host security clearance

reviewed_findings.disposition: A seeded PRNG shuffles whole-wafer indices for the statistical permutation screen; it is not used for cryptography, credentials or security-sensitive identifiers.
Intentional deterministic pseudo-random values are used only for synthetic catalog generation; they do not create secrets or security-sensitive identifiers.

limits: Advisory responses are point-in-time; scanner outputs do not provide an authoritative vulnerability database timestamp.
The Python scan covers the exact bundled macOS arm64 CPython 3.11 MCP wheel lock only.
The npm scan covers the current local P1 package lock snapshot by hash, not a P1 suite-host build or company target image.
Windows/Linux native assets, the unknown company target OS, company host controls and company threat review are not qualified.
Dependency scans do not establish redistribution rights or a first-party source license.
